items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 2:45PM EST until November 23 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt,
becoming north late Sunday afternoon and seas 6 to 9 ft
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light to Virginia-
North Carolina border out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 10 AM EST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
